reviewer.role: same agent that implemented the P0-H changes

limitations: This is not an independent reviewer assessment, penetration test, human certification, or legal opinion.
Source inspection was limited to the named V2.3 attack surfaces and linked existing tests; it was not exhaustive line-by-line review of the repository.
No hostile sample was processed, no production/user data was accessed, and no live third-party tool was invoked during this review.

coverage.evidence: Current full suite includes hostile ZIP/TAR path traversal, links, special files, collisions, and expansion-bound cases; members are indexed and not extracted.
coverage.remaining: No independent hostile-archive fuzzing or external corpus review.

coverage.evidence: Parser uses locked TypeScript 5.9.3 Compiler API; valid and invalid authored syntax fixtures run in the full suite.
coverage.remaining: Cross-file resolution, compiler semantics, data flow, and broad language support remain explicitly unsupported.

coverage.evidence: Invocation is bounded by timeout/output caps and analyzes a temporary exact input copy; existing real-tool run covered only self-authored fixtures.
coverage.remaining: Host execution is not a hostile-sample sandbox. Local Docker daemon availability is unverified; no hostile sample isolation or platform matrix was tested.

coverage.evidence: Existing tests cover credential-shaped text, secret fields, bounded summaries, and path redaction.
coverage.remaining: No independent leak review across every output serializer and external tool log.

coverage.evidence: Current suite covers trusted configured identity, bearer/session binding, cross-principal denial, and fixed L0-only workflow input.
coverage.remaining: No independent deployment-configuration review or external identity-provider integration test.

coverage.evidence: Code labels inputs as caller-supplied and unverified, does not execute either implementation, and limits equivalence statements to supplied cases.
coverage.remaining: Caller-supplied evidence references and certainty labels are not authenticated.

coverage.evidence: Post-source code/workflow edits are excluded from the evidence-only allowlist. Local negative tests cover validator/workflow/security-gate changes, allowlist expansion, and an older source SHA followed by source changes.
coverage.retest: 4/4 focused provenance tests passed locally; 654/654 full tests and TypeScript check passed at source commit 26a3e8edc81bf950cc7cdde37e027607121e207b. New workflow has not yet run on GitHub.

coverage.area: Dependencies, test fixtures, binaries, and license provenance
coverage.evidence: Lockfile contains TypeScript 5.9.3 with Apache-2.0; official npm registry audit at this SHA returned zero advisories. M3 records identify compiled fixtures and the Zig input hash; the current SBOM generator declares optional external tools as not bundled.
coverage.remaining: No final V2.3 package/SBOM exists. Exact license notices and redistribution terms for optional Ghidra/JDK/Zig/toolchain components and every binary fixture still need independent review.

findings.title: Independent human security review not obtained
findings.statement: This report is authored by the implementation agent and cannot satisfy the independent security gate.
findings.retest: OPEN; requires a separate qualified human reviewer and exact-candidate retest record.

findings.title: License and redistribution review incomplete
findings.statement: The current lockfile audit is not a license review; optional external binaries/toolchains and the final distributable inventory are not independently cleared.
findings.retest: OPEN; requires a separate reviewer, exact final file inventory, notices, and redistribution determination.

findings.title: Ghidra host execution is not hostile-sample isolation
findings.statement: Existing real-tool evidence uses project-authored fixtures on the host. It does not establish safe processing of hostile external binaries.
findings.retest: OPEN; release scope must either exclude hostile-input processing or add a separately verified isolation environment.

findings.title: Exact-main and protected-check configuration not verified
findings.statement: The PR workflow source can be exercised on the branch, but repository required-check/branch-protection settings and exact-main release provenance are not established by this local review.
findings.retest: OPEN; requires exact PR workflow run and maintainer-visible protection configuration; no merge was performed.

findings.title: Behavior comparison evidence is caller-asserted
findings.statement: Comparison inputs and evidence references are not authenticated by ArmorBreak; bounded results do not establish whole-program equivalence.
